unit.mapping: 1:1 at same logical width (iPhone SoT; Android mirrors same numbers as dp)

reference.notes: Values are unscaled base (chrome.scale=1). Narrow widths multiply chrome.* by min(1, width/requiredWidth). Data-card / detail layoutScale is separate (detail content width / 377).

mapCard.notes: Main live map uses fixed 320pt height, not 4:3.

overlayAlign.notes: iOS↔Android size-parity overlays MUST align by brand/title row top Y, not screen top (status-bar / cutout heights differ). Crop or letterbox so the sansan brand title tops coincide, then compare chrome below.
overlayAlign.titleTopYFromScreenTop: safeAreaTopInset + headerBand.paddingVertical + max(0, (avatar - brandTitleSize) / 2)  (approx; prefer measured)
overlayAlign.measuredOn: iPhone 17 (DarkMode-iPhone17) 1206×2622 @3x; brand「sansan」ink top ≈84pt from screen top. Apply 1:1 as dp on Android at same logical width.

dataCard.layout: icon+label same row; value trailing/right-aligned; unit secondary gray (not tinted)

topButtons.notes: Touch target stays minTouch (44 iOS / 48 Android). Visible liquid-glass circle diameter matches iPhone toolbar control (~44pt at logical width 393).

mapCard.aspectNotes: Derived at logicalWidth 393 / referenceContentWidth 377 / referenceViewportHeight 780: min(contentWidth*4/3, viewportHeight*0.48)=374.4. Both platforms MUST use `height` as fixed pt/dp; do not recompute from aspect at runtime.

layoutAnchors.statusBarHandling: Inline nav sits below safe-area top inset (~59pt on iPhone 17). Toolbar ellipsis.circle center Y = safeTop + navBarHeight/2. Title card top = safeTop + navBarHeight + detail.topPadding (6).
layoutAnchors.notes: Overlays align on titleCardTopY (record title row), NOT screen top. Android mirrors topCircularButtonCenterY / titleCardTopY / mapCard.height as dp with the same status-bar+nav convention.
layoutAnchors.measuredOn: iPhone 17 (DarkMode-iPhone17) logical 402×874 @3x; Y anchors are screen-top pt (status-bar inclusive) and apply 1:1 at 393 SoT

overlayAlign.notes: Align overlays on navigationTitle「경로 모음」 / large-title baseline or list header top — not screen top.

androidPlaceholders.status: fill when Android sibling lands; leave null until mirrored
androidPlaceholders.note: Every numeric leaf above is iPhone pt SoT. Android column in PARITY-sizes.md uses same number as dp when mirrored 1:1.

mapUserLocation.source: iPhone main-map heading-up capture with beam visible (LaunchJW-iPhone17Pro dens-norm 1pt=3px). Sim has no magnetometer — DEBUG -UITestInjectHeading draws MapKit-style sector for SoT measure.
mapUserLocation.notes: Blue-dot + heading wedge. Android MUST mirror 1:1 as dp. Cone is a filled circular sector under the dot; not a stroked triangle. v27 90° was rejected (crop had no beam); v28 locked from beam-visible evidence.

behavior.northUp: mapBearing=0; cone rotates on screen with device heading (points toward heading vs north)
behavior.rotateHeadingUp: MapUserLocationButton follow-with-heading: map rotates so heading is screen-up; cone points toward top of screen
behavior.accuracyHalo: separate soft full circle — not the heading wedge

dark.notes: v26: Android MUST use cardFill #2C2C2E with stroke=none. Do not ship darker #1C1C1E card fill or hairline/outline stroke — iOS elevates by fill vs page only.
